answer: The fee-bearing attestation ledge is the mechanism that bites. Each agent identity must buy one separate, non-transferable attestation from an established node, and that purchase lands on a public ledger any verifier can replay. Since it can be neither pooled nor reused, a farm of a thousand puppets pays a thousand tolls before earning anything, and every unit is auditable. A quill marks honest vouchers, so reputation sticks only to names that were paid for. An attacker can only wander into wholesale buying, concentrating the loss where it is easy to trace.
